recipes.title: Face boxes on the face LCD (MirrorMode)
recipes.blurb: Camera feed on Vector’s screen with face (and related) overlays. Mode must be scheduled AND the mirror display flags enabled.

steps.note: Vision mode: run face detection so there is something to draw.
Vision mode: render camera to the face display (mirror screen).
Draw detections (objects/faces/markers) into the mirror image.
Extra face/eye-contact debug drawing (often the ‘boxes’ people notice).

tips: Faces + MirrorMode live under Vision.General.VisionModes (enum-named toggles).

recipes.title: Marker / charger detections in MirrorMode
recipes.blurb: Fiducial / marker overlays on the face camera feed.

steps.note: Vision mode for marker detection.
Show camera on face LCD.
Draw detections into mirror frame.
If > 0, also labels marker names (0–1 scale).

tips: DisplayMarkerNamesScale is under Vision.MirrorMode; 0 hides names.

recipes.title: Custom eye overlay (built-in pattern)
recipes.blurb: Tint/overlay procedural eyes with a built-in faceOverlays asset (pride flags, frog, galaxy, …).

steps.note: List: Trans,Lesbian,Gay,Bi,Pan,Frog,All,Galaxy,Custom. Pick any built-in 0–7.
Loads the selected overlay PNG/JPG into memory (required after changing the list).
Master switch: composite the loaded overlay onto procedural eyes.
Optional blend strength (0–1).

tips: Order matters: choose list → LoadFaceOverlay → tick CustomEyes.

recipes.title: Custom eye overlay from /data/data/customFaceOverlay.jpg
recipes.blurb: Same as built-in overlay, but uses your file on the robot after picking Custom in the list.

steps.note: Selects path /data/data/customFaceOverlay.jpg (see LoadCustomEyePNG).
Reads that file; fails silently if missing/empty — scp/curl the jpg first.
Enable overlay composite.
Blend opacity.

tips: Push an image first, e.g. curl -T my.jpg http://ROBOT:8889/… or scp to /data/data/customFaceOverlay.jpg
Image is resized to face display resolution if needed.
Re-press LoadFaceOverlay after replacing the file.

recipes.title: Record a mic data clip
recipes.blurb: Capture raw + processed mic audio for a few seconds (debug / ear pull).

steps.note: Clip length in ms (default 4000; range ~500–15000).
Starts the recording job (console function button).

tips: Clips land under cache micdata — see docs/development/mic-systems-overview.md and tools/ear_puller.py.

recipes.title: Stream mood into WebViz
recipes.blurb: Mood samples to the Mood WebViz tab at a useful rate.

steps.note: Seconds between mood pushes (smaller = more traffic).

recipes.title: Play a canned animation (anim process)
recipes.blurb: Fire a named animation from console (useful smoke test of anim stack).

steps.note: Args: name numLoops — change name to any known anim; ListAnimations dumps names.

tips: Use ListAnimations (no args) to print available names into the console-func result box.

Vision.blurb: Camera pipeline, vision modes, mirror display, face/marker debug. Engine only.

Vision.General.VisionModes.blurb: Per-VisionMode force-enable toggles (Faces, MirrorMode, Markers, …). Enabling also Dev-subscribes so the mode is scheduled.

Vision.MirrorMode.blurb: Drawing options for the on-face camera mirror image (detections, exposure text, gamma).

Vision.General.blurb: Cross-cutting vision debug flags (e.g. eye-contact drawing in mirror).

MicData.blurb: Microphone capture / clip recording. Anim process (:8889).

Face.ParameterizedFace.blurb: Procedural face drawing, AA, glow, custom eye overlays. Anim process (:8889). UI path often Face → ParameterizedFace.

Animations.blurb: List/play/abort canned animations on the anim process.

MirrorMode.blurb: Force-enable VisionMode::MirrorMode — camera on the face LCD.

DisplayEyeContactInMirrorMode.blurb: With MirrorMode, draw eye-contact / face debug (often the ‘boxes’).

DisplayDetectionsInMirrorMode.blurb: Draw detected objects, faces, and markers into the MirrorMode image.

DisplayExposureInMirrorMode.blurb: Overlay exposure / AE info on the mirror image.

DisplayMarkerNamesScale.blurb: Scale for marker name labels in mirror (0 = off).

MirrorModeGamma.blurb: Gamma for the mirrored camera image.

MirrorModeFaceDebugFontScale.blurb: Font scale for face debug text in mirror mode.

SendDebugImages.blurb: Send debug image streams from vision (bandwidth heavy).

ProcFace_CustomEyes.blurb: Composite a loaded eye overlay image onto procedural eyes. Requires LoadFaceOverlay first (and a valid overlay selection).

ProcFace_CustomEyeOverlay.blurb: Which overlay asset to load: 0–7 built-ins under faceOverlays/, 8 = Custom → /data/data/customFaceOverlay.jpg.

ProcFace_CustomEyeOpacity.blurb: Opacity when blending the custom eye overlay (0–1).

LoadFaceOverlay.blurb: Console function: load the file selected by ProcFace_CustomEyeOverlay into the procedural face drawer.

ProcFace_HotspotRender.blurb: Render eye glow / hotspot on procedural face.

RecordMicDataClip.blurb: Console function: record raw + processed mic for MicData_ClipRecordTime_ms.

PlayAnimation.blurb: Console function: play animation by name (args: name [numLoops]).

ListAnimations.blurb: Console function: dump animation names to the result box.

MoodManager_WebVizPeriod_s.blurb: How often mood state is pushed to WebViz Mood tab.

WebvizUpdatePeriod.blurb: Period used by some WebViz CPU-related updates.

ProfilerLogOutput.blurb: Profiler logging level (WebViz CpuProfile may set this).

RenderZOffset.blurb: Intended Z offset (mm) for QuadTreeProcessor debug render quads.
